margin_framing.metric_basis_note: Level and rate are both adjusted EBITDA margin on net sales. The 10%+ level is an undated long-term target set at the 2023-12-14 Investor Day and reaffirmed since; the dated rate is the fiscal 2026 guide (6.7% to 6.8%, about 100 bps YoY, CFO on three calls) plus a CEO aspiration of about 100 bps a year on average (2026-03-25). Chewy fiscal year ends late Jan/early Feb; Baba labels it by end year (Baba FY-2027 = Chewy fiscal 2026).

statements.quote: With respect to adjusted EBITDA margin, we expect to deliver north of 10% adjusted EBITDA margin, irrespective of the macro environment. So we will steadily and continuously improve and see that margin expansion over time.
statements.speaker: Stacy Bowman

statements.quote: So at Capital Markets in December of 2023, we put together a long-term model that had EBITDA margins at 10 points or more, 10% or more EBITDA margin as part of our long-term model.
statements.speaker: David Reeder
statements.doc_title: Morgan Stanley Technology, Media & Telecom Conference

statements.quote: These developments support our path to achieving our long-term adjusted EBITDA margin target of 10%.
statements.speaker: Sumit Singh
statements.doc_title: Chewy Inc Q1 2026 Earnings Call (Baba label; Chewy fiscal Q1 2025)

statements.quote: We want to, you know, also deliver, you know, 100 basis points of margin expansion on average. You can see that this print sets us up for a high-quality, durable performance, not just in 2026, but also 2027, right?
statements.speaker: Sumit Singh
statements.doc_title: Chewy Inc Q4 2026 Earnings Call (Baba label; Chewy fiscal Q4 2025)

statements.quote: You know, as we noted in the call, our long-term margin framework's unchanged and in 2026, we're gonna further expand profitability with the rate of expansion higher than 2025.
statements.speaker: Christopher Deppe
statements.doc_title: Chewy Inc Q4 2026 Earnings Call (Baba label; Chewy fiscal Q4 2025)

statements.quote: At the midpoint, this implies over 100 basis points of year-over-year adjusted EBITDA margin expansion and $912 million of adjusted EBITDA for fiscal 2026.
statements.speaker: Chris Deppe
statements.doc_title: Chewy Inc Q2 2027 Earnings Call (Baba label; Chewy fiscal Q2 2026)

statements.quote: Our confidence in hitting the long-term margin path of 10% plus EBITDA that we've mentioned is stronger at this point, and continues to strengthen with every quarter and year.
statements.speaker: Sumit Singh
statements.doc_title: Chewy Inc Q2 2027 Earnings Call (Baba label; Chewy fiscal Q2 2026)

street.gap_assumption: Baba FY labels (FY2026 = Chewy fiscal 2025 actual; FY2027 = fiscal 2026, equal to the $912M guide midpoint; FY2028 = fiscal 2027). No target year for 10%, so no formal gap. Consensus FY2029 7.92%, FY2031 8.59% (last year in the set), still 141 bps short of 10%; street adds about 46 bps a year FY2027 to FY2031 versus the CEO's about 100 bps average.

evidence_of_progress.note: Order [Q1 fiscal 2026, Q2 fiscal 2026]. Q1 7.5% adj. EBITDA margin, up about 130 bps (Deppe, doc 50122, 2026-06-10). Q2 6.8% vs 5.9% (10-Q doc 219191: $226.7M on $3,330.2M vs $183.3M on $3,104.2M), +90 bps computed, though the CFO said about $15M of Q2 upside was timing or discrete. FY2026 guide low end raised to 6.7% to 6.8% on 2026-09-09. Consensus 2QFY-2027 in Baba still shows the pre-print estimate; LTM uses 10-Q actuals.

verdict: Scores 9 on the rubric (stock down 62% at the bottom of its EV/EBITDA range, CEO and CFO repeatedly frame 10%+ adjusted EBITDA margin and about 100 bps a year while consensus reaches only 8.6% by FY2031), but it is a weaker GXO match than the score suggests: the catalyst is an internal CFO, CEO Sumit Singh is unchanged, and the 10% target dates from December 2023 with no target year.
open_questions: Will management attach a year to the 10%+ target, or is 'about 100 bps on average' the only dated commitment?
How much of fiscal 2027 margin expansion is absorbed by Modern Animal and vet clinic dilution versus the roughly $50M AI savings run rate?
Why does the street model only about 46 bps a year after fiscal 2026 when the company has delivered 90 to 130 bps in each recent quarter?
